limitations: One exact workflow/context/JOIN or tool-wait identity per event; no ordinal fallback.
Only known completions/services with an early FULL submit and recorded ACK are included.
Excluded or independently truncated observations remain unknown, not failed or wasted.
Shared protection owners follow recorded registration/release transitions only.
Unlocking is not eviction; a recorded lock is not input-complete execution readiness.
No release transition by service does not prove continuity outside the recorded prefix.
Command bytes may contain retransmission/shared pages; they are not unique attainable capacity.
Confirmed reuse retains the exact next-request proof; no claim that all unconfirmed bytes were wasted.
This is an observational population; no runtime lease, admission quota or workload changes are qualified.
